body.name: uStarZero
body.def: If \(\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}=\varnothing\), set \(u_*=0\). If the positive-margin search defining \(i_*\) succeeds, take the lexicographically least optimal basic solution at its first successful radius. Under the total fallback, take the lexicographically least rational feasible point returned by the exact feasibility program for \(i_*\).
body.role: total exhibited rational point, with interiority proved downstream
